Sonic Drift 2.name: Sonic Drift 2
Sonic Drift 2.summary: Start your engines and prepare for the race of your life! Choose from 7 of your favorite characters including Sonic, Knuckles and Robotnik, each with his own special powers. Plug in your Gear to Gear connector and take on a friend through over 17 courses in the ultimate Chaos Grand Prix!

Superman - The Man of Steel.name: Superman: The Man of Steel
Superman - The Man of Steel.summary: 2D scrolling action game developed by Graftgold and published in Europe only by Virgin Interactive. It is based on the earlier Superman game for the Genesis by Sunsoft.
